race.title: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Nursery
race.verdict: An open-looking sprint in which it could pay to side with NORTH STAR KODI , who boasts some strong maiden form at Hamilton back in the spring and the handicapper has given him a chance having failed to fire in a couple of nurseries thus far. Pride's Queen took a step forward switched to a nursery last time, so she heads up the dangers, with Commander Keith and Angelic Melody taken to fight out third. NORTH STAR KODI (IRE) PRIDE'S QUEEN COMMANDER KEITH (IRE)
